newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian shares close higher in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian shares close higher in quiet trade.

text.p: Nigerian equities closed generally higher in quiet Monday trading, dealers said.
The all-share index closed at 6270.89 from 6250.83 on Friday.

West African Portland Cement rose 50 kobo to 30 naira. PZ Industries gained 30 kobo to 34.20 naira. Unipetrol ended 40 kobo higher at 36 naira. Texaco closed five kobo higher at 24.22 naira. Cadbury and Union Dicon Salt gained 20 kobo each to close at 24.20 naira and 32.50 naira, while Flour Mills gained 10 kobo to 9.60 naira.
Construction firm G. Cappa continued its good run following its recent rights issue, closing 18 kobo higher at 6.20 naira. Lever Brothers rose 15 kobo to 25.00 naira
Aviation Development Co fell 20 kobo to 5.00 naira with a lot of shares on offer. Tyre maker Dunlop shed five kobo at 12.25 naira for the same reason.
Guinness ended five kobo down at 9.25 naira, while CFAO and Chemical and Allied Products fell 10 kobo to 5.00 naira and 8.10 naira, respectively.
Seven-Up Bottling Co was adjusted for dividend at 1.80 naira, down 20 kobo. ($1=80 naira)
